newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Foster's holders approve Asahi buyback.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Foster's holders approve Asahi buyback.

text.p: Shareholders in Australia's Foster's Brewing Group Ltd on Thursday overwhelmingly approved the buy-back of 254.5 million shares for A$625 million from Asahi Breweries Ltd.
The shares represent a 13 percent stake in Foster's.
The motion was passed on a show of hands with about 250 shareholders attending the meeting.
The buyback, announced last month, is the centrepiece of major changes to Foster's share register.
Another major investor, The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd, has already sold most of its 36.5 percent stake to brokerages which placed the stock with institutional and retail investors.
Chairman John Ralph told the meeting the restructuring of the share register had been the best result for the parties concerned.
"We are each going our own way because this is clearly what we see as best for each of us," he said.
"What is important, and very satisfying, is that this parting has been done very amicably and carried out with great goodwill."
By 11.40 a.m. (0140 GMT), Foster's shares were steady at A$2.60 with 1.7 million shares traded.
